pool.description: The RADOS pool containing the RBD images.

conffile.description: Path to the Ceph configuration file used to determine monitor addresses.

mountpoint.description: The local directory path where the FUSE filesystem is mounted.

fuse_options.description: List of additional options to pass to libfuse.

image.description: Specific RBD image name to mount. Empty string implies default behavior or pool-wide exposure.
